personalInfo.name: Bhargavi Govardhanam
personalInfo.title: AI Architect and Full Stack Engineer
personalInfo.summary: AI Architect and Full Stack Engineer with 11 years of experience delivering production-grade intelligent systems across healthcare, fintech, and enterprise domains. Equal depth on both sides: architecting LLM pipelines, RAG systems, and multi-agent agentic workflows with LangChain and LangGraph, and engineering high-performance React and FastAPI full stack applications deployed on Azure and AWS. Track record includes ML prototypes for fraud detection, credit risk, and predictive analytics.
personalInfo.role: AI Architect and Full Stack Engineer

experience.description: Architected and delivered an end-to-end Agentic RAG platform for a lending management modernization initiative, spanning a React 18 frontend and a Python FastAPI microservices backend deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Designed a multi-agent orchestration layer using LangChain and LangGraph, enabling autonomous document analysis, financial data extraction, and context-aware decision support across loan origination workflows.

Designed and integrated a GenAI-powered RAG chatbot for a healthcare and senior living platform, enabling natural language queries over resident care plans and health records. Built core application architecture using React 18 with functional components, Hooks, and Context API. Implemented complex multi-step forms reducing onboarding time by 40% and improving accuracy.

Led the architecture and development of a cross-border escrow platform's Vue.js frontend, implementing robust KYC workflows and seamless API integration with Go-based backend services. Spearheaded the migration from Vue 2 to Vue 3, improving system performance and maintainability while ensuring production stability on Azure Kubernetes Service.

Architected and led development of banking and loan origination UI systems using React and Vue, implementing role-based access controls and multi-step workflow systems. Built comprehensive file upload and validation platforms, optimized performance through lazy loading and code splitting, and led a team of 6 engineers while training 10+ new hires on Azure deployment best practices.

Developed enterprise web applications using React and AngularJS for Fortune 500 clients (Walmart, JB Hunt, AstraZeneca). Built HIPAA-compliant healthcare portals and high-performance logistics dashboards.
